title: Share or keep?

slides.title: Who made it?
slides.text: A picture, a song or a game level belongs to the person who made it. Finding it online does not mean you may use it.
slides.alt: Would you rather: use a picture someone else made and credit them, or draw your own, even if it is worse?

focus.cue: Use someone's picture: say who made it

slides.title: Read the badge
slides.text: Public domain: anyone may use it. Creative commons with credit: use it and say who made it. All rights reserved: ask first.

slides.title: Write a credit line
slides.text: A credit says what it is and who made it. It costs nothing, and it is how makers get found.

slides.title: Keep private things private
slides.text: Your games can be shared. Where you live, your school and your passphrase stay private.
slides.alt: Sorting the mail: where you live and your mailbox key are Keep, a favorite book is Share. Next up: a joke you made up.
